meta.promptText: I want to buy running shoes under ₹3000 in India. Which ones should I get?

response.text:
Finding a great pair of running shoes under ₹3,000 in India requires balancing durability, comfort, and proper cushioning. While entry-level shoes from premium brands often go on deep discount during online sales, specialized budget brands also offer stellar value.

The top-recommended running shoes under ₹3,000 include:

### 1. Decathlon Jogflow Series (Jogflow 100.1 / Jogflow 190.1)

* **Price Range:** ₹1,599 – ₹2,499[www.decathlon.in](https://www.decathlon.in/c/running-shoes-25400#:~:text=Kalenji%20Women%20Running%20Shoes%20Lightweight%2C%20Cushioned%2C%20Upto,Yard%20-%20Black.%203.9k.%20%E2%82%B91%2C599.%20MRP%20%E2%82%B92%2C499.)
* **Best For:** Beginners, daily jogging, and casual gym use (up to 10–20 km/week).[www.decathlon.in](https://www.decathlon.in/c/running-shoes-25400#:~:text=Search%20for%20%22Rain%20Co%22%7C%20%7C%20Shoes.%20Running,and%20Trail%20Shoes-Black%2FPink.%203.6k.%20%E2%82%B93%2C299.%20MRP%20%E2%82%B94%2C049.)
* **Why buy:** Decathlon’s Kalenji and Jogflow lines are legendary for value. The Jogflow 190.1 features enhanced cushioning and a comfortable mesh upper, making it arguably the most reliable and long-lasting pure running shoe at this price point.

### 2. Adidas Entry Performance Range (e.g., Duramo SL variants on sale, Clear Factor, or Zapid)

* **Price Range:** ₹2,000 – ₹3,000 (frequently discounted on the official Adidas India website or Myntra)[www.adidas.co.in](https://www.adidas.co.in/shoes_under_3000#:~:text=Extra%2015%25%20off%20above%204999.%20Sale%20price%E2%82%B92,Men%20Performance.%203%20colours.%20Sale%20price%E2%82%B92%20999.50.)
* **Best For:** Road running, daily trainers, and brand preference.
* **Why buy:** When sales hit, you can often grab marked-down Adidas performance running shoes. They offer great heel support, breathable uppers, and dependable rubber outsoles that outperform local fashion-brand sneakers.

### 3. Puma Entry Performance (e.g., Puma Conduct Pro or Galaxis Pro variants)

* **Price Range:** ₹2,200 – ₹3,000 (via Myntra, Flipkart, or Puma sales)
* **Best For:** Gym training, short-distance running, and style-conscious buyers.
* **Why buy:** Puma provides soft cushioning and trendy aesthetics. Models like the Conduct Pro offer decent shock absorption for light road running and treadmill sessions.

### 4. ASICS Jolt Series (Jolt 4 or entry-level variants when discounted)

* **Price Range:** Close to ₹2,500 – ₹3,000 during e-commerce sales (Flipkart/Amazon/Myntra)
* **Best For:** Neutral runners and walkers needing orthotic-friendly support.
* **Why buy:** If you catch a sale, ASICS entry shoes deliver incredible arch support and durability that easily outlasts competitors in the budget category.

---

### Quick Buying Tips:

* **Check the Sole:** Look for rubber pods on the outsole rather than pure foam bottoms; pure foam wears out within a few months of outdoor asphalt running.
* **Size Up:** Running feet swell slightly. It is usually wise to buy half a size or one full size up from your formal shoe size.

Are you looking for shoes primarily for outdoor running on asphalt, treadmill use, or general gym training?
